prompt: Product names and headings in our templates come out in whatever case people typed them in. Please add a titleCase built-in next to capitalize that turns text into title case, and wire it up and test it like the other text functions.
oracle: When we add titleCase, keep a, an, the, and, but, or, nor, of, in, on, at, to, for and by in lower case unless they are the first word.
